text: One hour. Start with a five-minute warm-up, then work through the examples together.
Ask the student to name three fractions that are equal to one half. Write them in a row and look for the pattern.
A percentage is a fraction out of 100. To turn a fraction into a percentage, make the denominator 100 (or divide and multiply by 100). Work through 3/4, 2/5 and 7/20 on the whiteboard.

prompt: Explain why 1/3 cannot be written as an exact whole-number percentage.
rubric: Notes 100 is not divisible by 3|Gives 33.3...% as the recurring value

text: Student writes one sentence explaining how to convert a fraction to a percentage in their own words.
